title: The current of a constant n-vector against a measure finite on compacts
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P any set, μ a measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and w ∈ NVector(ℝ^P, n) (a continuous linear functional on n-covectors). Then there is a current T ∈ D_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) such that (μ, x ↦ w) is a measure representation of T (IsMeasureRepresentation T μ (fun _ => w)): for every ω ∈ D^n(U), x ↦ w(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and T(ω) = ∫ w(ω(x)) dμ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (w : NVector (Eucl P) n), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → ∃ T : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsMeasureRepresentation T μ (fun _ => w)
